PINECREST SCHEDULING MONTHLY SERVICE AGREEMENT

Provider: Pinecrest Scheduling Co., 22 Alder Lane, Boise, ID 83702
Customer: Northfield Physical Therapy PLLC, 1405 Grove Street, Boise, ID 83706
Plan: Pinecrest Team, up to 10 staff accounts
Start Date: January 5, 2027
Fee: $120 per month, billed monthly in advance.

1. The Service

1.1 Pinecrest will provide Customer with access to its online appointment scheduling software, including the booking page, calendar sync, and text and email reminders to Customer's clients.

1.2 Pinecrest will provide support by email and chat on weekdays, and will aim to reply within one business day.

1.3 Customer may add or remove staff accounts at any time from the account settings page, up to the limit of the plan.

2. Term and Cancellation

2.1 This agreement runs month to month, starting on the Start Date.

2.2 Customer may cancel at any time from the account settings page or by emailing Pinecrest, and the cancellation takes effect at the end of the month already paid for.

2.3 Pinecrest does not charge any cancellation fee, and Customer owes nothing further after the paid month ends.

2.4 Pinecrest may end this agreement by giving Customer at least 30 days' written notice, and will refund any fees paid for days after the agreement ends.

3. Fees

3.1 Customer will pay the monthly fee by card on the same day each month, starting on the Start Date.

3.2 The monthly fee stays at $120 for as long as this agreement is in effect, and any change to the fee requires a new agreement signed by both parties.

3.3 If a card payment fails, Pinecrest will email Customer and retry the payment, and will not suspend access while it retries.

4. Customer Data

4.1 Customer owns all appointment records, client contact details and other information that Customer enters into the service.

4.2 Pinecrest will use that information only to run the service for Customer and will not sell it, rent it, or use it for advertising.

4.3 Pinecrest will keep the information encrypted in transit and at rest, and will tell Customer by email without undue delay if it learns that the information has been accessed without permission.

4.4 Customer may download all of its information as a spreadsheet at any time, including for 60 days after the agreement ends.

4.5 After those 60 days, Pinecrest will delete Customer's information from its systems, except for billing records it must keep by law.

5. Each Party's Responsibilities

5.1 Customer is responsible for getting its clients' consent to receive appointment reminders by text message and email.

5.2 Customer will keep its staff passwords private and will tell Pinecrest promptly if it believes an account has been misused.

5.3 Pinecrest will keep the booking page available except during short maintenance windows, which it will schedule outside Customer's listed business hours where possible.

5.4 Each party will keep the other's non-public business information private and will use it only to carry out this agreement.

6. Changes to This Agreement

6.1 This agreement can be changed only by a written amendment signed by both parties.

7. General

7.1 This document is the whole agreement between Pinecrest and Customer about the service.

7.2 Either party may send notices under this agreement by email to the address the other party has on file.

7.3 Neither party may transfer this agreement to someone else without the other party's written consent.

Signed for Pinecrest Scheduling Co.: Owen Achebe, Operations Manager
Signed for Northfield Physical Therapy PLLC: Priya Lindqvist, Clinic Director
